model.name: Poolside Laguna S 2.1
model.weights: actual layer-1 shared and layer-0 dense gate/up

protocol.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_t16_dense_dual_decode_leaf.py --candidate q8-dp4a --warmups 5 --samples 21 --burst 100 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-shared-q8-dp4a-leaf.json
protocol.timing: counterbalanced HIP events; candidate includes one BF16-to-Q8_1 pack plus the existing Q4T16 dp4a fused-SiLU consumer

decision.reason: The already-available q8_1 pack plus dp4a consumer loses every actual-weight pair before a layout-specialized implementation is justified. Shared is 47.69% slower and dense is 5.64% slower, while both introduce approximation error.
